own.title: Your data
own.text: Download a copy of everything this workspace holds about you (profile, leave, attendance, events, notifications) as a JSON file.

employee.title: Personal data
employee.text: Subject access requests and erasure of a former employee's data.
employee.downloaded: The file was downloaded. This export was recorded in the audit log.

erase.title: Erase the personal data of {{name}}?
erase.removes: Removed: name, contact details, birth date, job details, login, notifications and all free-text notes and comments.
erase.keeps: Kept without personal details, as the law requires: hire and termination dates, working-time and leave records.
erase.understand: I understand that this is irreversible.

conflict.active: Deactivate the employee first. Only former employees can be erased.
conflict.self: You cannot erase your own data.
conflict.erased: The personal data of this employee was already erased.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.intro: Former employees are anonymised automatically a set time after they left, so personal data is not kept longer than needed.
retention.notLegalAdvice: The period below is a default for Bulgaria, not legal advice. Please confirm it with your legal adviser or data protection officer before turning this on.
retention.confirmOn: From now on, every former employee is anonymised {{months}} months after their termination date. This cannot be undone for a person. People on hold are skipped.
retention.whatErased: Name, contact details, job title, notes, goals, reviews, feedback, 1:1 meetings, skills, working hours, assistant conversations and the login account of the person are removed or made unreadable.
retention.whatStays: Hire and termination dates, attendance times and leave days stay, without a connection to the person, because records of that kind may have to be kept.
retention.upcomingIntro: Put a person on hold to keep them out of the automatic erasure, for example during a dispute. HR can still erase a person by hand at any time.
retention.withoutDate_one: {{count}} former employee has no termination date and is never erased automatically.
retention.withoutDate_other: {{count}} former employees have no termination date and are never erased automatically.
